description: Pattern-scan this project's OWN code for common vulnerability classes (OWASP/CWE): hardcoded secrets, SQL injection via string concatenation, eval/shell injection, insecure deserialization, weak crypto, SSRF, path traversal, and IDOR-prone lookups — with file:line and a fix for each. Pattern matching, not proof: read a finding before changing code. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded. Run this before finishing a feature/PR that touches routes, queries, auth, serialization or file/network I/O; codexguild_sync also runs it once at session start.

cwd.description: Project directory (defaults to the current directory)

name: codexguild_scan_security
